stated: Reform UK will accept in full the Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy Committee 2021 recommendations to amend the Mineworkers Pension Scheme arrangements so that all scheme surpluses accrue to the Mineworkers.

source.quote: End the Mineworkers Pension Scandal We accept the Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy Committee 2021 recommendations in full to amend the Mineworkers Pension Scheme arrangements so that all the scheme surpluses accrue to the Mineworkers.

bearing_set.reason: Redirecting Mineworkers Pension Scheme surpluses entirely to beneficiaries rather than splitting them with the government would directly raise retirement income for former miners, bearing materially on pensioner adequacy.

The government currently takes a 50% share of MPS surpluses (reported cumulative transfers of several billion pounds); relinquishing that revenue stream is a material, recurring fiscal cost that widens the funded/borrowed gap — a non-negligible O12 harm mechanism.

membership_note: The policy has two clear non-negligible bearings: a benefit to mineworker pensioners (O8) and a fiscal cost to the exchequer (O12). Effects on inequality (O14) are real but too narrow in population scope to clear the non-negligible bar at the economy-wide level.
